---
title: "Geographic Distribution Explorer (2021–2026)"
subtitle: "Filter sightings by year, month, and coastal zone—and toggle spatial observation hotspots across Sarasota Bay"
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(leaflet)
library(crosstalk)

dolphins <- read_csv("data/florida_dolphins_2021_2026.csv") |>
  distinct(gbif_id, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  mutate(
    month_name = factor(month.name[month], levels = month.name),
    season = case_when(
      month %in% c(12, 1, 2) ~ "Winter",
      month %in% c(3, 4, 5)  ~ "Spring",
      month %in% c(6, 7, 8)  ~ "Summer",
      TRUE                   ~ "Autumn"
    ),
    pod_text = if_else(is.na(group_size), "Presence verified (count not recorded)", paste0(group_size, " dolphin(s)")),
    popup_html = paste0(
      "<b>Visual Sighting</b><br>",
      "<b>Date:</b> ", event_date,
      if_else(!is.na(event_time) & event_time != "", paste0(" at ", substr(event_time, 1, 5)), ""), "<br>",
      "<b>Zone:</b> ", region, "<br>",
      "<b>Pod Size:</b> ", pod_text, "<br>",
      "<b>Coordinates:</b> ", round(lat, 4), "°N, ", abs(round(lon, 4)), "°W<br>",
      "<b>Dataset:</b> ", source
    )
  )

# Compute 0.03-degree (~3 km) spatial frequency grid around Greater Sarasota Bay for the interactive heatmap layer
grid_step <- 0.03
heat_grid <- dolphins |>
  filter(lat >= 26.75, lat <= 27.65, lon >= -82.90, lon <= -82.25) |>
  mutate(
    lat_bin = floor(lat / grid_step) * grid_step,
    lon_bin = floor(lon / grid_step) * grid_step
  ) |>
  summarize(sightings = n(), .by = c(lat_bin, lon_bin))

heat_pal <- colorNumeric(
  palette = c("#ffffb2", "#fecc5c", "#fd8d3c", "#f03b20", "#bd0026"),
  domain = heat_grid$sightings
)

# Publicly documented Sarasota Bay Listening Network (SBLN) reference station areas
# (Station locations only; raw acoustic detection CSVs require SDRP permission)
sbln_ref <- tibble(
  station = c(
    "Palma Sola Bay (SBLN Reference)",
    "Cortez / Anna Maria Sound (SBLN Reference)",
    "New College Caples Pier (SBLN Reference)",
    "City Island / Mote Marine Lab (SBLN Reference)",
    "Historic Spanish Point / Little Sarasota Bay (SBLN Reference)"
  ),
  lat = c(27.484, 27.468, 27.385, 27.334, 27.206),
  lon = c(-82.658, -82.688, -82.563, -82.578, -82.497),
  note = "Passive acoustic hydrophone area documented in SDRP / NCF research. Raw 2021–2026 whistle detection logs require formal SDRP data-sharing permission."
)

shared_geo <- SharedData$new(dolphins)

season_pal <- colorFactor(
  palette = c("Winter" = "#0b2545", "Spring" = "#2a9d8f", "Summer" = "#e76f51", "Autumn" = "#f4a261"),
  levels = c("Winter", "Spring", "Summer", "Autumn")
)
```

Use the filters below to explore where bottlenose dolphins were spotted between **January 2021 and November 2026**. The map opens zoomed into **Sarasota Bay**, with layer toggles on the top right so you can switch on the **Observation Frequency Heatmap** (~3 km grid cells) or inspect **SBLN Reference Hydrophone Locations** alongside individual visual sightings.

::: {.filter-box}
```{r}
filter_checkbox(
  id = "geo_year",
  label = "Year (2021–2026)",
  sharedData = shared_geo,
  group = ~year,
  inline = TRUE
)

filter_select(
  id = "geo_month",
  label = "Month of Year",
  sharedData = shared_geo,
  group = ~month_name
)

filter_select(
  id = "geo_region",
  label = "Coastal Study Zone",
  sharedData = shared_geo,
  group = ~region
)
```
:::

```{r}
leaflet(shared_geo, height = 560) |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) |>
  setView(lng = -82.58, lat = 27.34, zoom = 10) |>
  # Spatial frequency heatmap grid over Greater Sarasota Bay
  addRectangles(
    data = heat_grid,
    lng1 = ~lon_bin,
    lat1 = ~lat_bin,
    lng2 = ~(lon_bin + grid_step),
    lat2 = ~(lat_bin + grid_step),
    fillColor = ~heat_pal(sightings),
    fillOpacity = 0.48,
    color = "#ffffff",
    weight = 0.5,
    popup = ~paste0("<b>Grid Cell Frequency (2021–2026):</b> ", sightings, " visual sightings"),
    group = "Sarasota Bay Frequency Heatmap"
  ) |>
  # Individual filterable visual sightings
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~lon,
    lat = ~lat,
    radius = 5.5,
    color = ~season_pal(season),
    stroke = TRUE,
    weight = 1,
    fillOpacity = 0.78,
    popup = ~popup_html,
    group = "Visual Sightings (Filterable)"
  ) |>
  # Documented SBLN reference listening station areas
  addCircleMarkers(
    data = sbln_ref,
    lng = ~lon,
    lat = ~lat,
    radius = 7,
    color = "#6a0dad",
    fillColor = "#9d4edd",
    stroke = TRUE,
    weight = 2,
    fillOpacity = 0.9,
    popup = ~paste0("<b>", station, "</b><br>", note),
    group = "SBLN Hydrophone Stations (Ref Only)"
  ) |>
  addLayersControl(
    overlayGroups = c(
      "Visual Sightings (Filterable)",
      "Sarasota Bay Frequency Heatmap",
      "SBLN Hydrophone Stations (Ref Only)"
    ),
    options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
  ) |>
  addLegend(
    position = "bottomleft",
    pal = season_pal,
    values = ~season,
    title = "Visual Sighting Season",
    opacity = 0.9
  ) |>
  addLegend(
    position = "bottomright",
    pal = heat_pal,
    values = heat_grid$sightings,
    title = "Grid Sightings",
    opacity = 0.8
  )
```

> **Interpreting geographic concentrations:** High cell counts near **Big Sarasota Pass**, **New Pass**, **City Island**, **Anna Maria Sound**, and **Venice Inlet** reflect both prime tidal foraging bottlenecks *and* easy shoreline/boater access where observers frequently photograph dolphins.
